feeds.title: World Curling Federation
feeds.description: The World Curling Federation is the world governing body of the Olympic winter sport of curling and the Paralympic winter sport of wheelchair curling. Originally founded in 1966 as the International Curling Federation, it changed its name to the World Curling Federation in 1990. Having a mission to lead the worldwide curling community through the promotion and development of our sport, our culture and our values.

feeds.title: CURLSASK
feeds.description: CURLSASK is the provincial sport governing body of curling in Saskatchewan, proudly promotes & supports the sport for all participants. Our mission is to promote and develop the future of curling in Saskatchewan by providing leadership, services and programs for the curling community, from Grassroots to Elite. We are proud of curling in Saskatchewan and strive to continually improve our performance in all areas of our organization.

feeds.title: Scottish Curling
feeds.description: Scottish Curling is the National Governing Body for the sport of curling in Scotland. Scottish Curling is the trading name of the Royal Caledonian Curling Club (RCCC), established in 1838. With approximately 12,000 members in around 600 clubs, it is one of the largest governing bodies of sport in Scotland. Our mission is to develop a robust infrastructure of clubs and facilities that will support the growth of the sport, increase the number of people who enjoy curling in Scotland and sustain medal success at world-class levels.

feeds.title: CurlManitoba
feeds.description: The Provincial Governing Body for curling in Manitoba. Proudly promoting, developing, and supporting the sport!

feeds.title: OttawaSUN » Curling News
feeds.description: Ottawa Sun is part of the Postmedia Network, one of Canada largest print and digital news networks. News, Sports, Entertainment, Comment from Canada's Capital. Words, photos, video, blogs, chats, forums & more are covered by Ottawa Sun. Subscribe the blog to stay updated with Curling news.

feeds.title: The Grand Slam of Curling
feeds.description: The Grand Slam Of Curling is owned and operated by Sportsnet, a Rogers Media company. The Pinty Grand Slam of Curling is an annual series of events featuring the top-ranked curling men and women teams in the world.

feeds.title: Curling Day in Canada
feeds.description: Curling Canada is a Canadian organization responsible for encouraging and facilitating growth and development of the sport of curling in Canada. The primary area of administration and the most financially consuming of Curling Canada are championships. On an annual basis, Curling Canada sanctions and conducts nine national curling championship events. It also provides a broad array of programs and services to its Member Associations. Their updates are being conveyed through the blog.

feeds.title: In the House
feeds.description: Michael Fournier is the founder of In the House blog which provides a review of competitive curling happenings in Quebec and Eastern Canada from an insider. He is a Curler, Strategic Consultant, Dad and still harbouring obscure fantasies about winning the Brier.

feeds.title: Curling History
feeds.description: The Curling History blog was set up in 2008 by curling historian David B Smith and Bob Cowan, former Editor of the Scottish Curler magazine. The history of curling is an initiative hoping that the blog would bring together all interested in the history of this great sport.

feeds.title: Irish Curling Association
feeds.description: The Irish Curling Association is a body set up to develop and represent the game of curling in Ireland.

feeds.title: Street Curling Blog
feeds.description: The ultimate curling attraction for your next facility or event. Learn how playing the emerging sport of curling on synthetic ice is both fun and realistic. Street Curling is synthetic iceless curling that allows winter's hottest sport to be played virtually anywhere.

feeds.title: Finger Lakes Curling Club
feeds.description: The Finger Lakes Curling Club is a not-for-profit organization based in Ithaca, NY. We are committed to bringing the sport of curling to those interested in learning more about this great sport the physical, strategic, and social aspects! The Finger Lakes Curling Club is open to all people who are interested in the sport of curling.

feeds.title: Portage Daily Graphic » Portage Curling News
feeds.description: Stay updated on curling in Portage - read the latest news, stats and updates on your favourite curling teams in Portage, Canada and the world.

feeds.title: British Curling
feeds.description: British Curling is the organisation that manages and develops elite curling in Britain. We are responsible for delivering an elite performance programme for the sport that will ensure British curlers can achieve their potential and, ultimately, deliver medals in Olympic and Paralympic competition. Responsible for delivering medal-winning moments at Olympic, Paralympic, World and European Championships, we work closely with our partners at Scottish, English and Welsh Curling, UK Sport and sports Scotland.

feeds.title: Curling Alberta
feeds.description: Curling Alberta believed in spreading the power of sport through curling. We are committed to protecting the health and happiness of future generations while honouring our rich history. For all ages and abilities, Curling Alberta will provide equitable and quality opportunities to participate in our sport, striving to make curling the first sport of choice for all within our boundaries.

feeds.title: The Curling News
feeds.description: THE CURLING NEWS boasts the best contributors in the sport today, continuing a legacy of six decades of comprehensive curling coverage. Each issue offers insightful commentary, specific departments, the world first and only monthly Curling TV/Web Guide listings, and all the news you cannot find anywhere else. The only independent curling newspaper, founded in 1957.
